entry.content:
Issues

Created

    12.0.0

    12.0-preview1

Closed

  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: disposing a SqliteCommand closes its open SqliteDataReader #39336
    12.0-preview1

    12.0-preview1

    12.0-preview1

    12.0-preview1
  • No items when projecting out groupings with a null key #32026
    12.0-preview1
  • SQLite: JSON property names that need quoting translate to a ->> path that never matches #39328
    12.0-preview1

    12.0-preview1

    12.0-preview1

    12.0-preview1

    area-infrastructure

    area-infrastructure

    community-contribution

    community-contribution

    community-contribution
  • Read schema metadata for TEMP and attached tables in SqliteDataReaderGetSchemaTable #39383
    community-contribution
  • Translate DateTime.Millisecond on SQLite without floating-point trunation #39382
    community-contribution
  • Keep unnamed bits when generating [Flags] enum literals in CSharpHelper #39381
    community-contribution
